deadline.value: No call for a September 2027 start is listed yet. The 1st call (deadline 1 July 2026) and the 2nd call (deadline 18 September 2026) of the 42nd cycle have closed; the next listed calls start in February and May 2027.
deadline.quote: There currently no open calls for which it is possible to apply.

also.quote: 1st Call 42nd cycle 2026/2027 - deadline 1 July 2026 - starting date 11 September 2026
15 March 2027: 4th call 42nd Cycle - Deadline 15 April 2027 (start of activities: 1 May 2027)

gre_subject.value: The official admission pages do not mention a GRE Subject test for this programme.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by an adjudication committee of professors; the research project is approved by the Teaching Committee after admission.
supervisor.quote: Candidates are evaluated by an adjudication committee composed of professors from the departments involved in the selection process.

also.quote: L'ammissione al Dottorato di Ricerca avviene tramite selezione ed è regolato da un bando di Dottorato
If admitted, the actual doctoral research project will be defined and approved by the Teaching Committee of the relevant doctoral program

funding.value: Scholarships are awarded through the calls and a ranking, and some positions have no scholarship; the minimum scholarship is €1,300.
funding.quote: The calls, offer both general and topic-specific scholarships

also.quote: There are also positions without scholarships
Once your application is confirmed, you can wait for the ranking to be published
The minimum amount of the scholarship is €1,300

entry_route.value: A Master's degree (Laurea Magistrale) or an equivalent qualification valid for PhD admission is required; applicants who lack it at the deadline can apply and be admitted conditionally.
entry_route.quote: Have obtained a Master’s degree (Laurea Magistrale) in Italy (or an equivalent qualification valid for PhD admission)

also.quote: Equivalent foreign qualifications, comparable in duration and content to the Italian degrees
You may submit an application even if you do not yet possess the required qualification by the application deadline

notes: Taught in English, 3 years, Milano Leonardo. Department programme site (Italian): 'L'ammissione al Dottorato di Ricerca avviene tramite selezione ed è regolato da un bando di Dottorato'. No department-specific fee, GRE or English rule found.
